name: NOOP PaceForge
subtitle: WHOOP data with athlete-focused coaching and training context.
description: NOOP PaceForge reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth and computes its own metrics on your iPhone. Data stays on-device by default. If you enable the optional PaceForge connection, NOOP syncs to the PaceForge server you configure so the shared Coach can use NOOP and PaceForge training data. Not affiliated with WHOOP.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 491: dismiss or snooze live alerts, page paragraphs, Today's call, Day in review and race week; no Start workout bar at the top of Today.
Build 490: a short assessment paragraph at the top of each screen, live alerts for stress, heart rate and Body Battery on Today, and less repeated content on Today and Body.
Build 489: every metric's info sheet now shows where it stands for you and what PaceForge does with it, on top of build 488's restored readiness safety gates.
Build 487: unified Coach entry and shared NOOP/PaceForge context, clearer briefing status, and direct Sleep and Training navigation.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NOOP connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NOOP reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NOOP writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NOOP records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: NOOP reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
